payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection tasks, including improvements in performance metrics over prior work.

claims.text: Previous work on speculation detection has shown varying results, with improvements reported in cue detection and scope resolution tasks.

The application of transformer-based architectures has led to substantial improvements over previously reported results, specifically by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
Joint training on multiple datasets outperforms single dataset training approaches, indicating better performance than previously reported.
